PlantScope Oman
Process & feasibility intelligence for Oman

PlantScope Oman

Plan an industrial plant anywhere in Oman — from the site to the process.

Pick a plant and a capacity, choose any area on the map, and get the capital cost, NPV and IRR, the mass and energy balance, a block flow diagram, the carbon footprint, a sized heat exchanger and a PDF report — in English or Arabic.

What it does

Map & project register

50 documented projects across Oman with operator, capacity, status, investment and sources.

Cost & feasibility

CAPEX, OPEX, NPV, IRR, payback and unit cost, with three scenarios and a sensitivity tornado.

Process engineering

Mass and energy balance, block flow diagram with the flows on every stream, and CAPEX by process unit.

Heat exchanger sizing

Shell-and-tube rating by the Kern method, auto-sized for a stream of your plant, with ΔP and over-design checks.

Carbon & 24-hour profile

CO₂ against the conventional route, and the solar field, electrolyser and storage a design day needs.

A PDF report for any area

Search a place or draw any polygon, and export a bilingual report with the plant priced at that location.

    4

    Compare candidate sites

    Pick two to four sites and compare cost, return and suitability for the plant you planned above.

    Candidate sites

    Any point can be added as a candidate. Its factors are derived from the published port and housing positions and from the surveyed sites — an estimate, not a survey.

    5

    Report & sources

    Export the full brief — assumptions, costs, financials, sensitivity, site score, risks and every source.

    One button, three scopes: the full brief, this area only, or the portfolio — then HTML or PDF.

    The exported report carries an engineering appendix: the edited inputs with their sources, and the automatic safety and environmental screening. The outputs remain preliminary screening estimates.

    Selected area —

    A detailed brief for this area only — its projects, the cost scenario priced inside it, the financial case, the sensitivity analysis, the site score and the risks.

    Model validation against Oman's disclosed projects

    The same model run against every tracked project that publishes both a capacity and an investment value. Scope differences (a cracker, a renewables farm, an export terminal) explain most of the gap.
